metrics.algorithm: COMPOSE -> PRACTISE -> CONSOLIDATE: (1) compose once from the demo (borrowing every frame + the 258 KB fold where the demo grasps); (2) practise on instances = init states 0-19, recording every rollout (m5_practice, tag dimbest); (3) remember every successful rollout as a program in the demo's format (state keys + action sequence) and refit the fold on the demo + the successes' contact windows (same rank, layers, steps); failed rollouts are not imitated; (4) redo: at episode start pick the stored composition (demo or success) whose initial state is nearest; on an instance solved before this is its own success

arms.lora_same_data: rank-16 LoRA trained on the demo + the same successful rollouts (all frames), always on

metrics.bytes: first composition + ~(2 (T+9) 7 + 16 T) bytes per stored success; the refit fold replaces the demo's fold (same size)

hypotheses.L1: REDO: on the practice instances the first composition solved, the consolidated agent succeeds >= 0.9 of the time
hypotheses.L2: REDO: on the practice instances it failed, the consolidated agent does better than the first composition did
hypotheses.L3: GENERALISE (states 30-49): consolidated > first composition (paired, sign test p < 0.05)
hypotheses.L4: GENERALISE: consolidated non-inferior to the LoRA trained on the same data at -0.10

metrics.tasks: the 21 tasks where the prior's practice fails
